rows.adsb_note: CORROBORATED IN THE AIR, NOT ON THE GROUND. Closest recovered position is 1.4 km from KICT at 342 ft above the field - an arrival, a departure or a low pass. This trace holds no on-ground positions at all, which is ordinary: receiver coverage of a parked aircraft is thin. It places NOBODY aboard.
rows.source: TPUSA tour press list (event); audit index 23 accurate, index 24 partial
rows.counterargument: THE PAIRING POINTS THE WRONG WAY. On the one day Charlie Kirk is documented in Kansas, the aircraft LEFT - departing at 08:43 am and flying out of the state. It had already sat at Wichita five days, arriving 29 Mar, well before a 3 Apr Lawrence appearance was operationally relevant to anything. Nearest airports to the venue are KLWC and KMCI (~50 mi), NOT Wichita, 160 miles away. Wichita is the Air Capital of the World and Yingling Aviation at KICT is an FAA Part 145 Dassault Falcon service centre: a Falcon 7X landing at Wichita is the most ordinary thing a Falcon 7X can do.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The strongest Kansas pairing in the record, and it cuts against the claim. THE WICHITA TALLY IS THE CLEAREST ILLUSTRATION OF HOW THESE COUNTS INFLATE: a claim of 'no fewer than 8 stops' by SU-BTT at Wichita resolves against the audit into THREE confirmed visits (Nov 2022, Apr 2023, Mar-Apr 2024) plus NINE claimed Wichita entries on dates the aircraft was in Egypt (indices 22, 31, 32, 33, 34, 45, 51, 54, 59, 61, 63), TWO of which are literal duplicates of two others (61 duplicates 31; 63 duplicates 33).

ground_stay.notes: THE SEPTEMBER WINDOW. Six days on the Provo ramp, departing the morning of the assassination. The audit marks the arrival accurate and the departure accurate while CORRECTING its stated origin from 'Paris' to Provo: 'PROVO, NOT PARIS, FOLLOWED BY WILMINGTON THEN CAIRO.' Departure time is DISPUTED - 7:08 AM MT vs 7:14 AM local in the researcher chronology vs other readings. COUNTERARGUMENT: neither Kirk is documented at Provo at any point during this stay; Charlie Kirk was in Seoul on 5-6 Sep and Tokyo on 7 Sep.
